story_text: As a user, I want to update the priority of an existing task so that I can reprioritize my work.

positive.title: Update task priority to each valid value
steps: 1. Create a task with an initial priority.
2. Update the task's priority to each valid value (e.g., Low, Medium, High).
3. Retrieve the task after each update to verify the priority change.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · priority updated and reflected in response

positive.title: Update task priority to the same value
steps: 1. Create a task with an initial priority.
2. Update the task's priority to the same value.
3. Retrieve the task to verify the priority remains unchanged.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · priority remains unchanged and reflected in response

positive.title: Update task priority and verify persistence
steps: 1. Create a task with an initial priority.
2. Update the task's priority to a new valid value.
3. Retrieve the task to verify the priority change is persisted.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · priority updated and reflected in response, and persists on subsequent retrieval

negative.title: Update priority to an invalid value
steps: 1. Create a task with an initial priority.
2. Attempt to update the task's priority to an invalid value (e.g., 'Urgent').
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states priority must be a valid value

negative.title: Update priority of a non-existent task
steps: 1. Attempt to update the priority of a task that does not exist.
2. Verify the response.
negative.expected_result: 404 Not Found · message states task not found

negative.title: Update task with no authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to update the priority of an existing task without providing authentication credentials.
2. Verify the response.
negative.expected_result: 401 Unauthorized · message states user not authenticated

negative.title: Update another user's task
steps: 1. Attempt to update the priority of a task that belongs to another user.
2. Verify the response.
negative.expected_result: 403 Forbidden · message states user not authorized to update this task

edge.title: Update priority to null
steps: 1. Create a task with an initial priority.
2. Attempt to update the task's priority to null.
3. Verify the response.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states priority cannot be null
